The home screen now has three balanced columns: Leaderboard on the left, name and difficulty in the middle, PhishSense Masters on the right. It's committed as "Balance home screen columns" and pushed to **`New_Features`**, not `Abigail_Front_End_Work`. Your saved note from earlier today says your work goes to `New_Features` even when a pasted task names the Abigail branch. If you want it on the Abigail branch as well, tell me and I'll push it there.

**Checked at 1920×1080 and 1366×768** with a headless Chrome and made-up players:
- Both side cards start at the same top edge and are the same width and height.
- The middle column has exactly the same space on each side (24px).
- On every row, the points sit on the same line as the name and line up on the right.

**What changed:**
1. **Leaderboard rows** show rank, then name and badge icons, then points. Nothing wraps; a long name ends in "…" and the full name shows on hover. The 🏆 for Masters now sits with the badge icons.
2. **Leaderboard** shows the top 7. The end-of-game screen shares this list, so it shows 7 too.
3. **Masters card** lists every Master with 🏆, name and points, using the same row layout. The Masters come from all players the server sends, not only the top 7. The "Earn all 3 badges to become a PhishSense Master" line is at the bottom of the card, with the fish, rod and anchor icons under it. With no Masters it says "No Masters yet. Be the first!"
4. **Under 900px wide**, it stacks: logo, name, difficulty, Masters, then Leaderboard. Headless Chrome won't render narrower than about 500px, so I confirmed the order at that width but couldn't test a real 390px phone screen.

The commit also includes the earlier uncommitted changes from this session. One is the server change from 10 to 50 players in `server.js` and `README.md`, which isn't front-end only, so I'm flagging it. The others are the shimmer and the offline-list fix.
